long_biography.plain_text:
Mark A. Gensheimer founded Penn-Florida Companies in Boca Raton in 1987 after earning a business degree from Central Michigan University. He developed the private company across the property cycle, combining development, capitalization, acquisition, disposition, brokerage and asset management. Its portfolio came to span office, retail, industrial, medical, apartment, residential and golf-course projects across Florida.

His most ambitious undertaking has been Via Mizner, a mixed-use district conceived around apartments, shops, a Mandarin Oriental hotel and residences, and a private golf and city club. Gensheimer assembled and financed the project over many years while remaining Penn-Florida's founder and president. The venture illustrates his approach: concentrating on complex, luxury properties in select markets and linking ownership with hands-on development and operation. His career pairs local market knowledge with sophisticated project capitalization.
